member.name: T:Slots.Rng.IRng
member.summary: Randomness source. In a game engine the RNG is always injected and seeded — never global (Math.random(), Random.Shared, etc.).

member.name: M:Slots.Rng.IRng.NextUInt
member.summary: Next 32 raw bits from the generator.

member.name: M:Slots.Rng.IRng.Next(System.UInt32)
member.summary: Uniform integer greater than or equal to 0 and less than — that is, from 0 to maxExclusive − 1. The value of is never drawn.

member.name: T:Slots.Rng.Pcg32
member.summary: PCG-XSH-RR 32-bit (O'Neill). Deterministic and reproducible on any machine, unlike System.Random, whose algorithm may vary across runtime versions.
